items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: The guy that owned the show, Captain John Sheesley, he come, and he hit the cat in the head with his cane.

ctx.x: All through Canada. All over. All over Canada and through the Midwest, you know. Then we came down back South. We hit...

Well, the first time I really knew about this prejudice thing is when we got to Cumberland, Maryland. And I seen something happen there that really shook me up, you know. We was playing a prayer date. And this Black guy had his stand like right here, you know, and when we come in, they put the ropes up on one side of his stand, like on these seats for that part of the stage you know. So the guy just asked him, 'Would you move, just move... You're blocking the seats here.' So man, they went into their thing, you…

So the policeman was signalling to us. See, I figured the policeman would stop it, you know. The policeman took the Black cats to jail. ....[INAUDIBLE TWO SENTENCES].... And that night I was on the train right back to Pittsburgh.
